svg.text: A new session: who reads the queue, and who closes the gap
What happens between the old session ending and the first quiet wait, before and after this change.

g.text: Before: two turns, and a read nobody saw
Session start reads the queue inside the
startup hook and marks what it prints as
shown. Firstmate receives the first 2,000
characters of about 62,000.
Turn 1 answers in one line. The old
watcher died with its lock still held, so
its downtime is not even on record yet.
The next watcher finds the dead lock
and announces a recovery whatever is
queued: turn 2, empty 30 times in 32.
After: one turn, and the read that counts is Firstmate's own
Session start previews the queue and
marks nothing. Its first line says nothing
is waiting, or how many are and to run
the drain.
It takes the dead watcher's lock over and,
when nothing is waiting, acknowledges that
downtime itself. Anything waiting: it
settles nothing.
The next watcher starts quietly. A wake
that is waiting or arrives later still gets
its notification, with nothing already
marked as shown.

svg.text: Counts are from 38 recorded session rotations, 18 to 24 November 2026.
